name: Blind persona identification
definition: Evaluates whether a judge can identify or score the intended persona from anonymized generated-student behavior.
unit: anonymized transcript or probe response set
judge_context_inputs: candidate persona contracts (full contract including description, familiar/unfamiliar concepts, emotional profile with expanded description, behavioral rules, persona-specific expectations, failure modes)

score_scales.1: Incorrect or indistinguishable. The identified persona is wrong, or the transcript is generic enough that no persona can be justified.
score_scales.2: Weak identification. No Score 1 failure, but evidence is sparse, mostly generic, or conflicts with important parts of the intended persona.
score_scales.3: Ambiguous but plausible. The intended persona is recoverable, but evidence is incomplete or another candidate remains plausible.
score_scales.4: Strong identification. The intended persona is identified with clear evidence and only minor ambiguity.
score_scales.5: Excellent identification. The intended persona is identified with high confidence and specific evidence across knowledge boundary, emotional profile, and behavioral rules.

aggregation_formula: identification accuracy and confidence by persona/model/probe group
